articles.title: Wall Street gets new crypto rival after Texas bank completes regulatory pivot
articles.snippet: By establishing a national charter under the executive branch, United Texas Bank said it intends to enable AI-driven payment rails to intercept global digital dollar volumes.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Internet Computer (ICP) Jumps 9.8%
articles.snippet: Stellar (XLM), up 1.7%, joined Internet Computer (ICP) as a top performer.

articles.title: Solana DEX Orca launches new marketplace for tokenized real-world assets
articles.snippet: The launch comes as crypto companies increasingly focus on tokenizing traditional financial assets, a market many in the industry see as a major growth opportunity.

articles.title: ETHConf brings Ethereum’s leaders, institutions, and policymakers to New York City on June 8–10
articles.snippet: ETHConf, produced by ETHGlobal, will bring more than 5,000 attendees, 150+ speakers, and 100+ companies to the Javits Center in New York City from June 8-10, 2026 for three days focused on the future of Ethereum and institutional finance.

articles.title: Sharplink, Forward Industries among crypto firms considered for Russell indexes
articles.snippet: Bitmine and Galaxy Digital may also be eligible for the Russell 1000, an index tracking the largest 1,000 US companies that includes Nvidia, Microsoft and Apple.
